headline: Maersk Upgrades Full-Year Profit Guidance on High Freight Rates
summary: Danish shipping giant Maersk upgraded its 2026 profit outlook for a third time due to congested ports, resilient consumer demand, and AI investments.
why: As a bellwether for global container shipping and international trade, Maersk's guidance updates signal broader trends in supply chain dynamics and global commerce.
